name: National Plastic Industries Limited
about: National Plastic Industries Limited manufactures and markets moulded plastic furniture and allied products under the NATIONAL brand name in India. The company offers furniture products, such as premium event chairs, premium chairs, without arm tent, popular chair, cabinet, baby chair, box, table, stool, household, drawer, and rack office chair. It also exports its products. The company serves households, institutions, small establishments, and public utilities. National Plastic Industries Limited was founded in 1952 and is based in Mumbai, India.
